photograph.title: 2010 Shanghai Bund, Viewed from Oriental Pearl Tower 02
photograph.author: Gary Lee Todd, Ph.D.
photograph.source_location_note: Commons GPS indicates the photographed Bund vicinity, not the Oriental Pearl camera location. Identification uses the distinctive 17/18/19 facades and road crossings.

photo_observation.location_anchor: Consecutive North China Daily News/AIA (17), Chartered Bank (18), Palace Hotel (19), with the two mapped crossings south and north of the beds.
photo_observation.observed_objects: Two long, narrow low grass beds with pale shallow stone edging and sparse trees beside the river-side road curb, separated by a paved gap.
photo_observation.pixel_region_note: Manually identified approximate bounding regions on the unchanged 4752×3168 photograph, with vegetation and bus occlusion. Not a calibrated camera solution or metre-scale survey.

photo_observation.control_point_accuracy: Approximate 15–30px identification uncertainty; OSM footway endpoints may extend beyond painted stripe ends. No independently validated 2D homography or ground-metre reprojection error is claimed.

dimensions.basis: Shallow edging morphology supported by photograph; all vertical dimensions are reconstruction estimates on existing flat game datum.

limitations: Photo is from 2010; it does not certify present vegetation or unchanged construction in 2026.
The four-corner plan geometry follows frozen OSM recesses exactly; their classification as planting is inferred by building/crossing order and photo morphology, not an explicit OSM landuse tag.
No independently calibrated full image-to-ground homography or measured metre accuracy is claimed.
Stone width/heights and grass/soil levels are estimates; no tree species, counts or positions are added.
Existing elevated promenade/floodwall topography is not reconstructed. The flat walk datum is retained.
Older connector audit keeps its original unknown-opening terminology; these separate additions refine classification without changing prior connector geometry.
